itens.titulo: BlackRock seeks to shield Bitcoin investors from losses after rival fund weathers 50% crash
itens.descricao: BlackRock seeks to shield Bitcoin investors from losses after rival fund weathers 50% crash CoinDesk
trechos: BlackRock seeks to shield bitcoin investors from losses after rival fund weathers 50% crash BlackRock's proposed fund follows similar products from Calamos that helped investors avoid steep losses during bitcoin's selloff.
- Calamos' protected bitcoin ETF lost just 1% since October 2025, even as bitcoin tumbled more than 50% from its peak.

The Naperville, Illinois-based firm's Bitcoin Structured Alt Protection ETF – October (CBOO) dropped just 1% since the start of its one-year protection period in October 2025, according to a Calamos spokesperson.
The largest cryptocurrency, in contrast, tumbled as much as 52% from its record high of roughly $126,000.

"The Fund seeks to provide upside exposure to the iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF and/or similar bitcoin exposure up to an approximate limit, while seeking to provide a level of downside protection," BlackRock said in the filing.
The proposed fund would build on BlackRock's flagship iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT), which manages more than $65 billion in assets and is the largest of the U.S.
Calamos debuted its first three protected bitcoin ETFs in early 2025, offering investors a choice between full downside protection and funds that limit losses to 10% or 20% over a set period.
Calamos puts roughly 90% of the funds' assets into U.S.

itens.titulo: Dólar opera em queda e Ibovespa sobe, de olho no exterior e com eleição no radar
itens.descricao: Dólar opera em queda e Ibovespa sobe, de olho no exterior e com eleição no radar G1
trechos: O dólar opera em queda nesta terça-feira (20), com um recuo de 0,70% perto das 12h, cotado a R$ 5,0127.
Já o Ibovespa, principal índice da bolsa brasileira, tinha alta de 1,38% no mesmo horário, aos 207.900 pontos.

O movimento, iniciado por estudantes em meados de setembro com reivindicações sobre o sistema educacional, ganhou adesão de sindicatos e novas demandas, reunindo mais de meio milhão de pessoas na França.
- Na véspera, as taxas de juros dos títulos públicos da França com vencimento em 10 anos atingiram 4,95%, uma das piores marcas do ano.
- O barril do Brent, referência internacional, caía 2,82% perto das 12h, cotado a US$ 106,46.
Já o West Texas Intermediate (WTI), referência nos EUA, recuava 1,60% no mesmo horário, a US$ 102,00 o barril.
💲Dólar - Acumulado da semana: -0,49%; - Acumulado do mês: -2,44%; - Acumulado do ano: -8,03%.
📈Ibovespa - Acumulado da semana: -0,17% - Acumulado do mês: +10,06%; - Acumulado do ano: +27,28%.
